visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of several wet, silver metallic baking molds of various shapes sitting on a wire rack above a stainless steel sink. Water droplets are visible on the surfaces. (2) A man with wavy, shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a navy blue button-down shirt over a brown t-shirt, holds up a wet round cake mold. He looks directly at the camera with a confused expression. (3) A close-up view of the man's hands placing multiple fluted and round molds onto a flat black baking tray. The molds are spaced out. (4) The man carries the tray to a modern silver countertop oven and slides it into the center rack. The kitchen background is bright with white window frames. (5) The man opens the oven door and retrieves the tray of molds. Yellow stylized text appears on screen. (6) The man stands in a brightly lit kitchen with a white countertop and cabinets, holding the tray and gesturing with his free hand while talking to the camera. He smiles and looks confident.

An upbeat, major-key electronic BGM with a clear synthesizer pulse and a steady 124 BPM electronic drum beat starts simultaneously. (2) Sharp metallic clinking sounds occur as metal objects are shifted, overlaid by the continuous energetic narration. (3) A mechanical thud of an appliance door opening is heard, followed by a slight metallic sliding sound and a final solid latch click. (4) Vocal tone spikes in pitch and volume on the word 'Magic!', accompanied by a bright 'ding' sound effect. (5) Narration continues with a friendly, persuasive tone, concluding with a rapid-fire delivery of the final sentence over the sustained high-tempo electronic beat.
